description:
Welcome to Rick of All Trades – your neighborhood’s favorite all-American amateur of everything. I’m Rick: a guy with a drill, duct tape, and questionable confidence.

From backyard fixes and weird tool reviews to “well-that-didn’t-go-as-planned” home projects—I share real DIY solutions for real people (and maybe a few real mistakes).

If you've ever muttered, "Eh, close enough..." — this channel’s for you.

🔧 Subscribe for project walkthroughs, honest advice, and the occasional unscheduled spark.

Rick of All Trades: Master of None, but Still Fixing Stuff Anyway.
